-­‐ Essential guidelines and legislations in clinical research, -­‐ Professional conduct of clinical research, -­‐ Clinical trial monitoring, -­‐ Analysis of clinical research data, -­‐ Clinical research administrative skills, -­‐ Scientific presentation and communication, -­‐ Clinical study report writing, -­‐ Publication and grant writing.  2.3 Results and Performances My performance during these 12 months internship in IVI are outlined as followed: trainings attended, specific knowledge acquired, contribution to the team work, scientific publications/communications and the development of the letter of intent for EDCTP calls.   2.3.1 Trainings attended (including web-based training)  I have completed at least 9 training courses and 2 training are still on going as listed below:  -­‐ Essential Guidelines and International Regulations in clinical research Clinical Trial Monitoring, Online Training, Pharmaschool, 13/02/2016. Certificate Validation Code: 41439517 Topics covered: International Conference on Harmonization – Good Clinical Practice (ICH – GCP), Overview on European Union: Clinical Trial Directives, GCP Directives and Overview on FDA: Code of Federal Regulations Titles 21 Part 312, Tiles 21 Part 11. -­‐ Essential Documents, Online Training, Pharmaschool. 05/05/2016. Certificate Validation Code: 48605167 Topics covered: What Essential Documents are? Why do we have to have them? How to create them? When do we have to have them? How to maintain them? How long do we have to store them?  -­‐ Clinical Trial Monitoring, Online Training, Pharmaschool. 25/04/2016. Certificate Validation Code: 48430569 Topics covered: the Monitoring basics, the conduct of Site Selection Visit, the conduct of Site Initiation Visit, the conduct of Routine Monitoring Visit, the conduct of Site Close out Visit and Report and Follow - up Letter Writing. -­‐ Introduction to Clinical Research Data Analysis using “R”, Online Training, Université Paris Sud. 11/05/2016. https://www.fun-mooc.fr.
